goal: Reporter-only list, protected detail, and open-only edits for existing Python bug reports
decisions: Use the existing submission schema and a follow-on migration for read/update policies; do not rewrite the applied migration.
List only own reports newest first; show title, status, and creation time.
Only owning Reporters may edit open reports, and only the six content fields may be updated.
Normalize browser textarea CRLF and CR to LF for Python code while retaining indentation and trailing newlines.
findings: Code review found no blocking correctness issue and requested an end-to-end edit check.
Security review found no blocking authorization issue in the server action or RLS; anonymous UPDATE lacks a dedicated pgTAP assertion.
Initial verifier smoke found an unchanged Python snippet acquired CRLF after browser form submission; generator fixed shared form extraction and added a regression test.
Foreign detail returned a Next.js streamed not-found response with HTTP 200, but the not-found marker appeared and the foreign title/code were absent.

After handoff, the user reported a Next.js blocking-route error on / caused by reading searchParams outside Suspense. The obsolete home-page confirmation read was removed; creation already redirects to /reports.
acceptance_criteria: Reporter list shows only own reports newest first with title, status, and creation time; empty state links to creation.
Reporter can view own report and edit its six fields only while open, retaining owner and status.
Invalid or oversized edits show errors and retain entered text; unchanged Python source retains LF line endings.
Other users and non-Reporters cannot read or edit another report; database policy denies edits to closed reports.
verification: Independent verifier: npm run typecheck passed.
Independent verifier: npm run lint passed.
Independent verifier: npm test passed, 5 tests.
Independent verifier: npm run test:db passed, 2 files and 19 assertions.

Disposable signed-in two-user smoke: own list and detail rendered; valid edit redirected and retained owner/status; invalid edit returned errors and retained text; foreign detail disclosed no title/code.
Follow-up signed-in smoke: unchanged Python source retained LF exactly after saving; temporary report and accounts were removed.
Post-handoff home fix: npm run typecheck and npm run lint passed; disposable signed-in GET / returned 200 with both report links and no blocking-route error; temporary account removed.
remaining_work: Finish the broader T03 status/feedback and proposed-fix comparison story after Developer/QA work exists.
Add an explicit anonymous UPDATE pgTAP case in the broader authorization matrix if needed.
Release through the team's reviewed PR and deployment process; this local verification is not a production smoke test.
